name: Planning for emergency care with MND
description: MND-specific emergency planning guidance covering urgent care outside clinic hours, packed emergency bags, visible information lists, after-hours contacts, ambulance and emergency department preparation.
care_team_notes: Help the person prepare a short emergency script, packed bag, current medicine list, equipment list, communication plan, advance care documents and contact list for GP, neurologist, MND clinic, palliative care and local hospital.

name: Triple Zero communication options
description: Emergency communication record for calling Triple Zero by voice, text-to-speech, carer/support-person call, National Relay Service pathways, TTY 106 and clear short phrases for speech difficulty.
care_team_notes: Keep exact emergency numbers and relay instructions source-linked and current; store the user's address, diagnosis, communication method and priority needs in an accessible emergency note.

name: Breathing difficulty emergency plan
description: MND breathing support and emergency record covering breathlessness, weak cough, assisted coughing, non-invasive ventilation, respiratory equipment, shortness-of-breath warning signs and urgent escalation.
care_team_notes: Document baseline breathing support, NIV settings/equipment, cough-assist equipment, oxygen cautions if source-supported, respiratory physician contact and when to call emergency services.

name: Swallowing, choking and aspiration plan
description: Emergency-planning record for swallowing difficulty, choking episodes, aspiration risk, food/fluid texture, PEG/feeding-tube information, coughing episodes and caregiver preparation.
care_team_notes: Encourage speech pathologist/dietitian review, safe texture instructions, PEG notes, suction/cough plan if applicable and clear escalation steps for severe choking or breathing compromise.

name: Communication and care-needs handover
description: Emergency handover record covering AAC devices, speech difficulty, text-to-speech, carer communication support, My Care Needs forms and how to explain needs to ambulance or ED staff.
care_team_notes: Prepare a printable and digital communication card with diagnosis, preferred yes/no method, AAC device instructions, decision-maker details, positioning needs, medicines and equipment.

name: Advance care documents for emergency care
publisher: Healthdirect Australia / Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
description: Record for emergency availability of advance care plans/directives, substitute decision-maker details, values and treatment preferences when the person cannot communicate.
care_team_notes: Use state/territory forms from the advance-planning stage; keep copies with the person, carer, GP, treating hospital, My Health Record if appropriate and emergency bag.

name: Choosing urgent care, ambulance or ED
description: Australian urgent-care pathway record for deciding between GP, pharmacist, after-hours care, urgent care clinic, ambulance and emergency department.
care_team_notes: For serious or rapidly worsening breathing, choking, aspiration, severe pain, collapse, injury or inability to communicate urgent needs, route to emergency services rather than self-management.

name: Home emergency preparedness
description: Practical preparedness record for emergency bag contents, fridge/visible contact sheet, medicines, equipment chargers, NDIS/My Aged Care provider details, after-hours numbers and hospital preferences.
care_team_notes: Review the plan after major changes in speech, swallowing, breathing, mobility, medicines, address, support workers, care goals or equipment.
